about.missing_licences: The open-source licence list is unavailable. Review the legal directory supplied with this build.

home.title: Workspace
instance.already_running: Tallyline is already running. Its window could not be activated. Close this notice and switch to the existing window.
witness.on: Game log witness on — validated local facts
witness.input_limit: Game log witness unavailable: a source exceeds the input size limit.
witness.unvalidated_format: Game log witness unavailable: the log format or header is not validated.
witness.unvalidated_build: Game log witness unavailable: this exact build and branch have not been validated.
witness.read_failure: Game log witness unavailable: the selected manifest or Game.log could not be read.
witness.select_channel: Use channel and switch witness off
witness.title: Game log witness
witness.not_configured: Game log witness unavailable: select a game channel directory.
witness.explanation: Optional, local and read-only. Only validated terminal, buy-side assortment, container-size and major/minor version facts are inspected. No prices, quantities or status values are read into reports. Game.log is never included in diagnostics.
update.title: Release updates
update.explanation: Optional daily checks for standard Tallyline releases on GitHub. Only the app name and version are sent. Open release notes to choose whether to download an update yourself.
update.available: A new Tallyline release is available:
update.current: No newer standard release is available.
update.not_checked: No release update information is available yet.
update.unavailable: Release updates are unavailable. Work can continue. Checks will resume after the daily interval; Settings can turn them off.
update.dismissed: The available release notice was dismissed.
reference.title: Reference data
reference.offline: Offline - cached reference data remains available
reference.no_version: No version published for this environment
reference.no_terminals: No matching terminals in this environment
reference.no_commodities: No matching commodities in this environment
reference.worker_unavailable: Reference data refresh unavailable - cached data remains usable
reference.mapping_explanation: Choose the UEX environment for each game channel. This does not enable access to game files.
manual.title: Manual Report
manual.instructions: Choose the environment, terminal and side explicitly. Tab or Enter commits a field; status codes use the displayed number keys. Drafts are saved locally without credentials.
manual.terminal: Terminal · explicit selection required; recent terminals first
manual.affinity_help: Enter your affinity with the terminal's faction only if known. Changing terminal clears this field; side and environment changes keep it.
manual.invalid: Enter valid numbers. A traded price must be positive; faction affinity must be an integer from -100 to 100.
attachment.title: Private screenshot attachment
attachment.instructions: Select a local screenshot and enter the shop-panel rectangle in source pixels. Exclude the terminal header, balance and personal data. Only an explicitly confirmed region is saved; nothing is submitted.
attachment.source: Local screenshot path (or drop a file here)
attachment.full_size: Full-size private preview · 100% source scale · scroll to inspect the entire region
attachment.preview_alt: Selected private screenshot region at source scale
attachment.confirm_preview: Contains no balance or personal data
attachment.time_input: Confirmed observation time (UTC Unix seconds; earlier only)
attachment.confirm_time: Confirm shown time or move earlier
attachment.time_user: Observation time explicitly confirmed by the user
attachment.time_uncertain: Imported file time is uncertain. Confirm the shown time or enter an earlier observation time.
attachment.invalid_time: Enter a valid UTC Unix time no later than the Report observation time.
attachment.policy_unknown: No screenshot requirement is known for the current account. A manual Report may omit its image.
attachment.policy_unavailable: Screenshot policy could not be read. Retry the attachment check before release.
attachment.ready: Attachment checks passed. Other Report release checks are still required.
attachment.required_missing: This account requires a screenshot. Select and confirm a private region.
attachment.preview_unconfirmed: Inspect the full-size region and confirm that it contains no balance or personal data.
attachment.missing_or_changed: The saved private region is missing or changed. Select the source again and confirm its full-size preview.
attachment.conflict: The Draft changed while image work was pending. Reopen the current Draft and retry.
attachment.invalid_region: Select a non-empty shop-panel rectangle within the source image.
attachment.storage_unavailable: The private attachment could not be saved. Check access and free space, then retry. Current evidence remains blocked.
attachment.hdr: HDR source: choose an SDR copy before selecting a region.
attachment.unsupported: Unsupported image or colour metadata. Choose a supported SDR PNG, JPEG or BMP.
attachment.reduced: The image exceeds the source-scale intake budget. Choose a smaller source rather than reusing changed coordinates.
attachment.source_unavailable: The source could not be read within the image limits. Check the selected local file.
attachment.encoding_limit: The private image exceeds the screenshot encoding limit. Select a smaller region.
credentials.title: UEX account
credentials.local_use: You can browse and prepare drafts without an account. Credentials are required only to release reports.
credentials.session: Session-only credentials: enter them again after restarting
credentials.key_hint: Use your UEX secret key, not your RSI password or UEX app token.
credentials.expert: Expert: use my own app token
credentials.token_missing: The built-in app token is missing or unreadable. Enter your own token or install a current Tallyline release.
credentials.session_choice: Keep credentials for this session only
credentials.invalid_input: Enter a valid secret key and app token. Inputs must be printable ASCII and at most 1024 bytes each.
credentials.invalid_key: UEX refused the secret key. Check the key in your UEX profile.
credentials.not_allowed: This UEX account cannot submit DataRunner reports. Check your account status with UEX.
credentials.invalid_token: UEX refused the app token. Install a current Tallyline release or enter your own token using the expert option.
credentials.update: Update Tallyline before validating this account again.
credentials.unavailable: UEX could not be reached. Check your connection and try again. Your accepted account is unchanged.
credentials.storage_unavailable: The credential store is unavailable. Choose session-only credentials to continue without saving.
credentials.locked: The credential store is locked or access was declined. Unlock it yourself or choose session-only.
credentials.corrupt: The credential record is malformed or ambiguous. Check the secure store or choose session-only.
credentials.uncertain: The store may have changed without confirming the result. Reconcile it before another save. Your accepted account is unchanged.
credentials.save_failed: Credentials could not be saved. Check the secure store or choose session-only. Your accepted account is unchanged.
credentials.fallback_warning: Warning: Secret Service is unavailable. The Linux fallback stores your key and own token as plaintext in an owner-only local file. Other programs running as you can read it. Use it only on a trusted device, or choose session-only instead.
credentials.fallback_confirm: I understand: use the protected local file
attachment.input_limit: The image exceeds the header, pixel, colour-profile or memory limits. Choose a smaller SDR source with a bounded colour profile.
settings.stock_explanation: Both bands must be strictly exceeded for a major deviation. Changes apply on the next review without changing entered quantities.
settings.stock_invalid: Enter a whole percentage from 0 to 20 and an exact SCU minimum from 0 to 16. Looser or invalid values are not applied.
review.policy_scu: Provisional public-corpus baseline: 20 % and 16 SCU; independently tighten-only.
review.title: Price, stock and status review
review.pending: Review is waiting for the latest saved values and references.
review.scope: Prices, SCU quantities and statuses are assessed. Report release is not available.
review.revoked: Approval revoked · confirm the current value
review.no_preview: No private screenshot preview is available for this Draft.
review.view_attachment: View the saved private screenshot in the attachment section to cross-check the source.
review.updating: Updating reference checks. Approval is unavailable until the check finishes.
review.approval_scope: This approves the displayed value at its current deviation level. Editing the value clears this approval.
review.no_difference: Difference unavailable without a comparable reference.
review.average_band: Twice this tolerance applies to a commodity average.
queue.title: Submission queue and history
queue.split_result: Split into two released Reports. Each repeats the normal send checks.
queue.missing: This submission is no longer available. Refresh the queue.
queue.cannot_cancel: This submission cannot be cancelled in its current state.
queue.changed: The submission changed. Refresh the queue before trying again.
queue.unavailable: Queue storage is unavailable. The last saved state remains visible.
queue.no_uex_ids: The test created no UEX report IDs.
queue.no_replay: This request may have arrived. Automatic replay is blocked.
queue.connect_failure: The connection failed before sending. The queue retries with bounded backoff; Retry now is an explicit action.
queue.version_changed: The game version changed. Review the captured version before releasing the Report again.
queue.age_unconfirmed: Confirm the observation age before releasing the Report again.
queue.observation_too_old: The observation is too old to release.
queue.observation_in_future: The observation time is in the future. Review the time and system clock.
queue.invalid_observation_time: UEX refused the observation time. Review it and the system clock before releasing the Report again.
queue.review_required: Current values or evidence need review. Review and release the Report again.
queue.preflight_changed: The final checks changed before sending. No request was sent. Review and release the Report again.
queue.screenshot_required: This account requires a confirmed private screenshot. Review the attachment and release the Report again.
release.title: Release Report
release.full_gate: Release checks every entered row, current decisions, observation time, account and private evidence again. Test uses the same queue in dry-run mode.
release.changed: The displayed account, Report or settings changed. Review the current state before trying again.
release.numeric: Complete every entered row and confirm all required numerical decisions in review.
release.rows: A Report can contain at most 500 entered rows. Split and review it explicitly; no rows are omitted automatically.
release.reference: Current matching references are unavailable or a selected value is unknown. Refresh and review the Report.
release.stock: Stock must be a supported whole SCU quantity, including a known zero.
release.account: Validate this account read-only in this session before sending.
release.policy: The current account screenshot policy is unavailable. Sending remains closed.
release.preview: Confirm the exact private screenshot preview before release.
release.time: Review and confirm the original screenshot observation time.
release.working_copy: The selected private screenshot could not be verified. Review its attachment.
release.version: A known game version is required for the observation and selected environment.
release.version_history: Historical game-version evidence is unavailable for this older capture. Release remains closed; a current version string does not prove the capture version.
release.environment: Confirm the observed game environment and its target mapping.
release.history: Committed observation history is unavailable. Release remains closed.
release.newer: A newer observation was already accepted. Review that exact row and its observation before explicitly confirming an older submission.
release.unknown_newer: A newer request may have been processed. Resolve its uncertain outcome before releasing this older observation.
release.acceptance: UEX currently refuses submissions for this target. The released values and account remain fixed.
queue.app_token: App token missing or invalid. Check the token in Settings, then retry now.
queue.key_checked: UEX reported a key error, the key checked out. Retry now.
queue.reauthenticate: Re-authentication required. Validate the released account in Settings.
queue.account_check_pending: A read-only account check is pending. Sending remains paused.
queue.key_check_unavailable: The read-only account recheck is unavailable. Retry now when UEX is reachable.
queue.acceptance_closed: UEX acceptance is closed. The fixed Report is held for the next check.
queue.api_changed: API changed. The whole queue is held until an app update or retry now.
queue.service_unavailable: UEX did not process this request. The queue uses bounded backoff; Retry now repeats all current send checks.
release.onboarding_test: Try a reviewed manual Report first. Send test through queue uses dry-run mode, creates no UEX report IDs and changes no local price priors. A required screenshot is checked through the same queue.
settings.submission_explanation: Mode changes affect new releases only. Queued Reports keep their released account and mode. Development builds default to dry run; release builds default to production after setup.
settings.age_explanation: The age limit and confirmation lifetime can only be tightened from 60 minutes. The separate 24-hour hard limit always applies.
queue.wait_account: Paused: re-authenticate the released account in this session.
queue.wait_account_changed: Paused: another account is active. Keep pending for the released account or cancel and review.
queue.wait_inflight: Waiting for the current submission to finish.
queue.wait_earlier: Waiting for an older queued observation of the same row.
queue.wait_budget: Waiting for the complete Report to fit the 1,000-row production window.
queue.account_choice: Queued submissions belong to another account. Keep them for their released accounts or review and cancel them explicitly.
queue.keep_accounts: Keep pending for their released accounts
queue.retries_exhausted: Automatic retries are used up. Retry now explicitly or cancel for review.
queue.permanent_action: Update the app or report this technical code with the app version. Review the original data before preparing another Draft.
queue.invalid_game_version: UEX no longer accepts the captured game version. Capture a new observation with a valid game version. This Report cannot be retried or duplicated with its captured version.
queue.max_rows_exceeded: Reduce the Report to at most 500 rows, then review and release it again.
queue.terminal_not_found: Refresh the vocabulary and select the terminal again in the returned Draft.
queue.invalid_screenshot: Review and re-encode the private screenshot, then release the Draft again.
queue.partial_error: Rows may have been stored before this error:
queue.receipt_check_required: The read-only receipt check is unavailable. This Report stays held and cannot be resubmitted:
queue.rate_limited: UEX refused this request before processing. Waiting with bounded backoff for the row/rate budget.
queue.image_unavailable: UEX could not handle the screenshot before processing any row. Retrying with bounded backoff.
queue.daily_quota: The daily quota for the attempted app token is exhausted.
queue.update_required: UEX does not accept this Tallyline version. Update the app before sending again.
queue.duplicate_cooldown: The first row is already in cooldown. The complete Report waits before checking again.
queue.possibly_received: A duplicate is evidence that an earlier uncertain submission may have arrived. Review before release; earlier submission:
queue.global_daily_quota: Requests using this app token are held: its daily quota is exhausted.
queue.global_account_pause: All submissions are paused: complete the account recovery action and use Retry now on the originating submission.
queue.global_api_changed: All submissions are held: the UEX API changed. Use Retry now on the originating submission.
queue.unknown_received: Report submitted by your received decision. The original attempt remains unknown.
queue.unknown_not_received: Marked not received by you. The original outcome remains unknown.
queue.unknown_verified_full: Report submitted: every row has verified receipt evidence.
queue.unknown_partial: Report partially accepted; the remaining rows are unresolved.
queue.unknown_withdrawal_unavailable: Withdrawal is unavailable here; verified editable UEX identities are required.
queue.unknown_duplicate_evidence: Later duplicate evidence, not proof; submission:
release.resolved_duplicate_origin: The original submission now has verified received rows. This duplicate cannot be released; inspect the original history.
queue.quota_reset_unavailable: Quota reset time unavailable; this token remains held.
queue.quota_full_gate: Sending still requires all current checks to pass.
queue.quota_attempts_exhausted: Automatic attempts are exhausted. Cancel this report to review and release it again.
